title: UI风格#22 - Noir Mystery (黑色电影)
description: 创建第22种UI风格：黑色电影风格 - 黑白摄影、阴影戏剧、高对比度。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planV.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Mystery style When color palette Then features black, white, grays with dramatic shadows
Given Noir Mystery style When typography Then uses cinematic fonts: Playfair Display, Cormorant, or Lora
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Playfair Display (标题), Cormorant (正文), 或 Bebas Neue

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Mystery style When layout Then spotlight effects, shadow drama, cinematic framing
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：聚光灯效果、阴影戏剧、电影构图、宽屏比例

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Mystery style When UI elements Then film grain overlay, vignette shadows, dramatic reveals
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：胶片颗粒叠加、暗角阴影、戏剧性揭示、黑白转换

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Mystery UI When functional Then includes noir chat, shadowy agents, dramatic stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：黑色电影聊天、阴影代理、戏剧性统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Mystery UI When copy Then uses film noir language: 'Shadows', 'Spotlight', 'Mystery', 'Drama'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SHADOWS. SPOTLIGHT. MYSTERY.'、按钮'SEND'→'WHISPER'、'SUBMIT'→'REVEAL'
